name: Databricks Certified Context Engineer Associate

fee.note: USD list price before applicable taxes; hands-on practice access and feature availability need checking.

exam.format: 45 scored multiple-choice questions plus up to 10 unscored items, 90 minutes, proctored online or at a test center through Kryterion, in English. No test aids. Two-year validity. Six months of hands-on platform experience is recommended, not a formal prerequisite.

access.retake: Retakes are allowed after a 14-day wait with no limit on attempts; each attempt costs the full USD 200, and Databricks issues no free retake vouchers.

scope: Context, memory and governance for AI applications built on Databricks.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Databricks does not publish passing scores; it says they are set statistically and can change as the exam is updated.
This entry follows the exam version published July 29, 2026 (exam guide updated the same day). Databricks asks candidates to recheck the exam guide two weeks before their exam date.
Recertification is due every two years by passing the current version of the exam.
